volume_data_quality.issue: 92.8% of 09:15 IST hourly bars report volume 0 (13.7% of all hourly bars); 1.6% of 15:15 stubs too. Daily file is 1.5% zero-volume.
volume_data_quality.handling: Recomputed every hit's base/rally volume ratio excluding zero-volume bars and re-applied the 0.85 dry-up gate.
volume_data_quality.effect: NO name changed side. Max shift was 0.03 absolute (BLISSGVS 0.650 -> 0.682, AZAD 0.363 -> 0.388, LMW 0.414 -> 0.437); every hit sits far from the 0.85 gate, and zero bars land in base and rally windows at similar rates (~1 in 7 each), so the bias largely cancels. The one symbol the volume gate rejected outright (SIGMAADV) reads 3.32 naive and 3.15 corrected - rejected either way. Conclusion: the 09:15 zero-volume defect did not change which names passed the volume dry-up test in this run, but the corrected ratio is reported per hit as vol_ratio_zero_bars_excluded.
volume_data_quality.also: A separate artifact: 37 symbols carried a phantom 15:30 IST hourly bar with zero range and zero volume. Left in, it would have overwritten close[-1] and every dist-from-lip figure for those names. Dropped before scanning.

notes: HOURLY IS THE PRIMARY RESULT: 107 scanned -> 12 numeric hits -> 5 clean of context filters -> 2 confirmed on the chart (LMW, PAYTM). DAILY: 107 -> 7 numeric -> 3 confirmed (TVSMOTOR, RBLBANK, ETERNAL). No threshold was loosened anywhere; min_curvature stayed at the calibrated 0.015 and the diagnostic confirms it sits between the universe p90 and p95 on hourly. The 7 numeric hits killed by the visual pass split into two shapes the math cannot see: post-spike flat shelves (MARINE, AZAD, CRAFTSMAN, 360ONE) and short V-dips off vertical runs (BLISSGVS, TMB, RRKABEL). These are candidates matching a geometry, NOT recommendations - a 107-symbol curated list is not the NSE universe, hit rate is unknown without a backtest, and bases near highs behave very differently in a trending vs a choppy index. Prices come from the supplied parquet and the charts are matplotlib renderings; confirm levels on your own platform before acting.
